newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends up, March/May active.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends up, March/May active.

text.p: LIFFE white sugar futures ended higher amid active pre-expiry March/May trade.
March, the most active month, last traded $4.40 up at $308.00. March volume was 2,374 lots of a total 4,323.
May last traded $2.40 up at $303.00 on volume of 1,460 lots.
Players were making use of the little time remaining before the spot March expiry to roll positions forward and square their books, traders said.

Trade selling was countered by steady buying from a commission house which featured as a persistent seller earlier last week and also on Monday, they said. Some major players had moved between sell and buy sides, the traders added.
The Paris market also saw solid turnover but price movements were relatively tight. March was up 50 cents at $305.20. Matif volume totalled 2,329 lots.
